csv.anomaly_scope: one April 2024 TaxItemFeed file; not used for company/address/tenant attribution
csv.rowcount_crosscheck: all core/feed CSV scanner counts equal independent strict validator counts

contextual_crosswalk.strength: medium contextual, not authoritative ownership or continuous tenancy
contextual_crosswalk.method: same parsed support URL contains explicit cluster ID plus tenant/org ID; exact tenant/org value joins explicit account/org field
contextual_crosswalk.dates: issue creation/update dates, not proved cluster ownership interval
contextual_crosswalk.opaque_cluster_scan: 448 records with explicitly labeled 4-letter/26-alphanumeric cluster ID; zero tenant/known-company co-occurrence candidates

excluded_or_limited: No source authenticity or completeness attestation; evidence is supplied archive content.
Nested .tgz archives (17), PNG images (2), schema/source SQL (217) and other binary/source/config files were inventoried; their full semantic content was not comprehensively analyzed.

Parquet discovery scans business/name/geography/ID columns where available. About 10.99 million rows in other-column tables were not semantically analyzed; free-text/binary fields in Parquet are outside the discovery scan.
Text scan is a literal search for 23 corporate terms and Hong Kong spellings; mentions are not organization ownership proof and this is not exhaustive semantic entity recognition.
Broad discovery uses exact normalized business labels; aliases, source snapshots, resellers and marketing contacts must not be counted as unique affected companies.
Unreviewed business labels without clear organization form and personal-style labels are counted as exclusions, not published.
No credentials were tested, no infrastructure contacted, and no data uploaded.
Credential-category check covers only 286 contextually linked support records and narrow syntax forms; zero detections cannot establish absence.
SQL-like text may be diagnostic examples; no conclusion of customer database exfiltration follows.
Marketplace role observations are historical joins without validity-date enforcement; payer/reseller links are not customer-tenant ownership.
Coverage counts overlap across scans and must not be summed as distinct records.
